Class OperatorFixtures

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.tck.OperatorFixtures
public final class OperatorFixtures extends Object
Compiled fixtures: javac's == and != of two primitives, which promotes both operands to a common type (binary numeric promotion) - a long compared with a float is compared as a float. A generated referential comparison of the same operands must answer the same.
Since:
2.3
